results.title: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes (2026): Pricing, Features & Reviews Compared
results.snippet: TherapyNotes’ numbers are easier to read against a second competitor – the TheraPlatform and TherapyNotes pricing comparison runs the same tiers from solo practitioner up to enterprise. SimplePractice offers three plans: Starter at $49, Essential at $79, and Plus at $99 per month per practitioner (it periodically discounts the first months for new accounts).

results.title: SimplePractice Vs. TherapyNotes: Comparison, Cost, & Key Features
results.snippet: For a solo practice, SimplePractice’s entry plan is cheaper on paper: its plans run $49 to $99 per month, while TherapyNotes is $69 for a solo practitioner and $79 for the first clinician of a group (plus $50 per additional clinician). The real answer depends on add-ons: TherapyNotes includes more billing features in the base price, while SimplePractice charges more as you unlock features in higher tiers.

results.title: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes vs CarePaths: 2025
results.snippet: SimplePractice charges $35/month for similar functionality. TherapyNotes charges $40/month through their TherapyFuel add-on. At $49/month, CarePaths includes unlimited electronic claims, SMS reminders, telehealth, and the patient portal.

results.title: TherapyNotes vs SimplePractice (Compared): Cost, Features & Best Fit - DocResponse | Patient Engagement Software
results.snippet: Additional Services: TherapyNotes offers electronic prescriptions as an add-on service, which is a unique offering not mentioned in SimplePractice’s features. Cost-effectiveness: SimplePractice is considered more affordable, with basic plans starting at a lower price point compared to TherapyNotes.

results.title: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes (2026) | Which Fits You Best?
results.snippet: The SimplePractice Starter Plan is a more cost-effective option for solo practitioners compared to the TherapyNotes Solo Plan. However, as your practice expands, the price difference between the two platforms becomes less significant.
